data.description:
testing_mode: UPDATE

## Goal
Add source line + two new functions to `plugins/dso/scripts/merge-to-main-pr.sh`. All changes are ADDITIVE — do not modify existing functions.

## Changes

### 1. Add source line (alongside existing _MERGE_HELPERS_LIB source block)
```bash
# shellcheck source=plugins/dso/scripts/lib/ci-findings-normalize.sh
source "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/lib/ci-findings-normalize.sh"  # shim-exempt: internal plugin script
```

### 2. Add _REMEDIATE_LLM_CMD to env override documentation block
```
#   _REMEDIATE_LLM_CMD  — override LLM command for _dispatch_fix_agent (default: llm-api-call.sh)
#                         Intentionally separate from _LLM_DISPATCH_CMD to avoid colliding with
#                         the thread-resolution override in _phase_resolve_threads.
```

### 3. Add _dispatch_fix_agent <findings_path>
```bash
_dispatch_fix_agent() {
    local _findings_path="$1"
    local _llm_cmd="${_REMEDIATE_LLM_CMD:-${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/llm-api-call.sh}"  # shim-exempt: internal plugin script
    local _prompt_file="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/docs/workflows/prompts/review-fix-dispatch.md"
    local _result
    _result=$("$_llm_cmd" "$_prompt_file" "$_findings_path" "sonnet" 2>&1) || true
    case "$_result" in
        *"RESOLUTION_RESULT: FIXES_APPLIED"*) return 0 ;;
        *"RESOLUTION_RESULT: ESCALATE"*)      return 2 ;;
        *)                                     return 1 ;;
    esac
}
```

### 4. Add _phase_remediate <pr_number> <pr_url>
Full pipeline: get failed_run_id from state → download artifacts → find reviewer-findings.json → normalize → dispatch → CI-guarded push+commit → re-poll.

Key details:
- `find "$_artifacts_dir" -name 'reviewer-findings.json' -maxdepth 3 | head -1` to locate JSON
- All temp dirs/files via mktemp: `mktemp -d /tmp/dso-remediate-artifacts.XXXXXX` and `mktemp /tmp/dso-normalized.XXXXXX`
- CI guard BEFORE push: `if [[ "${CI:-}" != "true" ]]; then echo "WARNING: remediate push skipped outside CI" >&2; return 2; fi`
- REVIEW-DEFENSE comment: mirrors _pr_commit_code_change_threads lines 554-583 — same justification (CI-only, hook suite not installed)
- On non-zero _dispatch_fix_agent: return 2
- On non-zero download/find/normalize: return 2

## Files to modify
- plugins/dso/scripts/merge-to-main-pr.sh (existing — additive only: source line + 2 new functions)

## Verify
```
bash tests/scripts/test-merge-to-main-pr.sh 2>&1 | grep -cE "^PASS.*(t_dispatch_fix_agent|t_phase_remediate_wires|t_phase_remediate_on_fix|t_phase_remediate_on_artifact|t_phase_remediate_failure_exits|t_phase_remediate_on_repoll)"
```
Must output `6`
data.title: [T4b] Implement _dispatch_fix_agent and _phase_remediate in merge-to-main-pr.sh
